jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The girl attacks, hands on her hips, face three-quarters to the camera. The ex answers calmly, showing the car key. The father answers his daughter sternly, pointing at her, his face clearly visible.
chute: The ex smiles and lowers his eyes politely. The girl freezes, her hands still on her hips, mouth open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the angry girl's busted face looking into the camera.
